posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
If you deploy into your project directory (which will happen if you specify the folder where your project is located), then you are basically saving a second copy of your game into the project directory, and redirect the playtest to that second copy.
But the editor will always work on the original project files.
so if you add files after deploying into your project directory, the EDITOR will see them - but the PLAYTESTt will try to load the same files from the second copy where they do not exists.
please start the editor, then go into the menu game - open project folder.
in the folder that now opens, is there both an img directory AND a www directory?
If you have both, then you have damaged your project directory by placing a deployment into it.
in that case you need to make a new project, open the folders from both your damaged project and the new project, and then copy the packages file from the new project to the damaged one, overwriting the wrong deployment packages there.
if everything works after that, you can delete the www folder with the second copy.
Do NOT delete it before the packages file is replaced and everything works again.
